note: The HyperFrames engine draws our own gsap blocks (the hf: ports and any block with a gsap page) and the oh: pages through the renderat runtime (one iframe per block, driven per seek; the one-file measurement of V3b-1 showed the same frames as the ffmpeg engine within 40.33 dB mean and 37.4 dB minimum). presets names the block that draws each preset by default: the reviewed ports for the caption, the keyword, the number and the quote, and oh:list, which has no port. A beat may name another block of the same preset, an oh: block included. It draws no cutaway and no pip. The review-only presets mark, nametag and sticker are drawn by their oh: pages.
